verdict.rationale: The only PR-related evidence describes a manual action: the user asks the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view. Nothing documents configuring an agent to open a PR automatically when its task completes. Automation sessions (`humanlayer automation run`) are documented, but none of that evidence mentions PR creation, so this on-demand feature is an adjacent behavior, not the configured automatic one the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes
